messages.subject: Project Cedar — first-article inspection planning
messages.plaintextBody:
Hannah,

Now the Quality Agreement is signed, shall we set up the FAI planning meeting? We'll run AS9102 first-article on each controlled assembly (forward fuselage, wing box skins, V-tail, booms). Proposing the week of 12 January at our Filton site so your team can witness. I'll share the tooling design review dates separately.

Priya
